# The Modesty House

> The archive for everything modest. A curated index of modest brands and pieces.

The Modesty House is a curated women's modest-fashion directory: independent
Shopify storefronts, filtered to an aspirational, well-designed edit. It is
not a shop — there is no cart or checkout. Every product links out to the
brand's own site to complete a purchase.

## Sections

- [Products](https://themodestyhouse.com/directory): Browse modest pieces from every verified house.
- [Modest Dresses](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-dresses): Long-sleeve, high-neck and maxi dresses — styled for every occasion.
- [Abayas](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-abayas): Open, closed, kimono and butterfly abayas — from plain-sharp to embellished-flowing.
- [Hijabs & Scarves](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-hijabs): Chiffon, jersey, satin and crinkle hijabs, shawls and underscarves.
- [Skirts](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-skirts): Maxi, pleated and A-line skirts with full coverage.
- [Tops](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-tops): Tunics, blouses, shirts and layering tops.
- [Trousers](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-trousers): Wide-leg, tailored and relaxed trousers.
- [Co-ord Sets](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-sets): Matching two-piece sets and co-ords, styled to go.
- [Modest Swimwear](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-swimwear): Full-coverage swimsuits and burkinis for the beach and pool.
- [Modest Activewear](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-activewear): Sports dresses, leggings and covered athleisure for training and everyday movement.
- [Hijabi Outfits](https://themodestyhouse.com/hijabi-outfits): Hijabs, abayas and modest pieces from hijabi-owned brands.
- [Modest Wedding Guest](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-wedding-guest): Covered, elegant looks for weddings and formal occasions.
- [Modest Summer Outfits](https://themodestyhouse.com/modest-summer-outfits): Lightweight, breathable modest pieces for warm days.
- [Designers](https://themodestyhouse.com/designers): A curated index of modest brands, vetted for craft and taste.
- [The Edit](https://themodestyhouse.com/editorial): Stories, edits and styling from The Modesty House.
- [About](https://themodestyhouse.com/about): What The Modesty House does, the problem it solves, how it solves it, and who is behind it.

## Notes

- Product links are outbound affiliate links (`rel="sponsored"`) to the listed brand's own storefront — price and availability are the brand's, not ours, and should be attributed to the brand, not to The Modesty House.
- Editorial coverage (The Edit) is original and independently written.
- Full machine-readable listings: [sitemap.xml](https://themodestyhouse.com/sitemap.xml).
